## Features

- **Keypad brightness from keypad.json.** A `brightness` from 1 to 100 in `~/.config/tmux-legion/keypad.json` sets the keypad's panel brightness while the sidebar is open, and edits apply within a second. When the sidebar closes, your mx-keypad config's own `brightness` applies again, if it sets one. The starter file sets 70.
- **MX Dialpad bindings.** The file's `dialpad` section binds an MX Dialpad's four buttons, dial and roller in [mx-keypad's Dialpad format](https://github.com/hawkish/mx-keypad#add-an-mx-dialpad). mx-keypad's agent performs them while the sidebar is open. The starter file binds Escape, Enter and page turns to the buttons, volume to the dial, and the Up and Down arrow keys to the roller.
- **More starter keys.** The starter pages add Lock, Enter, `/plan`, and shortcuts for `autop git-message` and `nh darwin switch .`. Mute now sends Cmd+Shift+M. As before, tmux-legion writes the starter pages only when `keypad.json` doesn't exist yet. See [keypad/keypad.json](https://github.com/hawkish/tmux-legion/blob/v0.10.0/keypad/keypad.json).

## Maintenance

- Builds against [mx-keypad v0.10.0](https://github.com/hawkish/mx-keypad/releases/tag/v0.10.0), which adds the `brightness` message to the agent's socket. The Dialpad bindings need mx-keypad v0.9.0 or later, and brightness needs v0.10.0, on the agent too.

## Install

### Nix flake

```nix
# Pin to a release tag (recommended); drop the ref to track the default branch.
inputs.tmux-legion.url = "github:hawkish/tmux-legion/v0.10.0";
```

### Manual and TPM-style

```bash
git clone https://github.com/hawkish/tmux-legion ~/.tmux/plugins/tmux-legion
cd ~/.tmux/plugins/tmux-legion && cargo build --release
echo 'run-shell ~/.tmux/plugins/tmux-legion/tmux-legion.tmux' >> ~/.tmux.conf
```

Upgrading needs a tmux config reload, not just a rebuild — see [After upgrading](https://github.com/hawkish/tmux-legion#after-upgrading). The [README](https://github.com/hawkish/tmux-legion#install) covers Claude Code hooks, the agent skill, and the pi extension.
